assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at TK-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TK-4210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically managing freeboard, beach and decant. TK-4210 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 5 October 2021 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TK-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following an intrusive maintenance task.
